package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_algorithmic_complexity_quadratic_append_filter_pipeline: Layer: Algorithmic complexity. Flag append-based filter pipelines that rescan accumulated results for every input item.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Rule500PositiveRecord struct {
	ID     int
	Name   string
	Values []string
}

func scenario500Positive(records []Rule500PositiveRecord) []string {
	var results []string
	for _, r := range records {
		var filtered []string
		for _, v := range r.Values {
			if len(v) > 0 {
				filtered = append(filtered, v)
			}
		}
		for _, v := range filtered {
			results = append(results, v)
		}
	}
	return results
}
